title: Logged-out x.com is a different app the clipper cannot read: guest status
blocker: pages are server-rendered by a Relay/TanStack app with none of the logged-in DOM (`cellInnerDiv`, `tweetText`, `User-Name` testids absent; articles carry `data-tweet-id` + Tailwind classes), they fire no GraphQL requests (so x-page-hook relays nothing), and Defuddle's twitter extractor finds no main tweet. The full data - complete note_tweet text, whole X Article draft-js blocks - sits hydrated in the page's Relay store, reachable from any article's React fiber (env with `getStore()`; records `TweetResults:<id>`, text under `result.details.full_text`, user under `core.user_results.result.core`). The 2026-07-29 clip rescue proved this path end to end (clip repository, commit ef86110); decide whether the extension grows a guest-page fallback that mines the store the same way. Decided 2026-10-11 (Codex, high): keep deferred - React fiber and Relay store internals are a brittle dependency for a mode the owner rarely uses. Unblocks after repeated real guest-page captures fail; use those captures to define the required content.
